questions.explanation: Rocket Pool's $1.2B TVL on Ethereum signifies its strong position in the liquid staking sector, where it allows users to stake ETH while maintaining liquidity. Rocket Pool operates in the liquid staking category, allowing users to stake their ETH while still retaining liquidity through tokenized representations of their staked assets. This model addresses the common challenge of illiquidity in traditional staking, enabling users to participate in both staking rewards and DeFi activities simultaneously.

questions.prompt: In what month did Rocket Pool hit its all-time high TVL?
